SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No 4818 Narcotic Section Station Dated 29 / 4 / 33）

Subject (in full) Modus Operandi of Pill Manufacturing

Made by D.I. Papp Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Recently 3 cases came to notice of pill manufacturers using foreign style houses for the purpose of manufacturing opium substitutes. These dwellings have been found to be new constructions and had all windows painted up or pasted up with paper. The work of manufacturing pills was being performed during the night.

In view of the above facts I most respectfully beg to request that the attention of the Police on night duties be called to the above facts with instructions to report any such houses for the purpose of further investigations.

（左侧手写批注：It might be better if all foreigners were warned to keep their eyes open for such places. J.Q.）

R. Papp
D.I.

Forwarded.
J. Quayle
Supt.
C.I

D.C. (Crime)

D.C. (Dir)
a good suggestion

（签名）
D. C. (CRIME)
25 APR. 1933

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股 登记室 档案号 4818 毒品科 日期 1933年4月29日）

事由（全称） 药丸制造手法

由警督帕普（Papp）呈报，经警司奎尔（Quayle）转呈

近期有三起案件引起注意，涉及药丸制造商利用西式住宅制造鸦片替代品。经查，这些住所均为新建建筑，且所有窗户均被油漆封死或用纸糊住。药丸制造工作均在夜间进行。

鉴于上述事实，卑职谨请提请夜间执勤警员注意上述情况，并指示其报告任何此类房屋，以便进一步调查。

（左侧手写批注：若警告所有外国人对此类场所保持警惕，或许更为妥当。J.Q.）

R. 帕普（Papp）
警督

已转呈。
J. 奎尔（Quayle）
